scanNote:
6-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (42-bet).

Yuqorida chapda PUShTI-QIZIL yorliqda oq '6' va 'Food, Glorious Food'.

CHAP USTUN:
9) a) 'Fill in: BAKE, BOIL, POACH, STEAM, FRY.' (qiya harflarda) Beshta gap, nuqtali joylar.
   b) 'Name some foods which can be FRIED, POACHED, BAKED, BOILED or STEAMED.' Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'Eggs, chicken, mushrooms and bacon can be FRIED.'
10) 'Underline the odd word out.'
   SURAT: kartonli quti ichida oq tuxumlar, qizil kosada makkajo'xori laylaklari (cornflakes), oq piyolada qora qahva likobcha bilan, uzun stakanda sut.
   O'nta qator, har birida QALIN idish so'zi va uch-to'rt ovqat:
   1 a BAR of chocolate, soap, bread
   2 a CARTON of orange juice, bacon, milk
   3 a SLICE of bread, ham, butter, cake
   4 a CUP of coffee, meat, tea, hot chocolate
   5 a BOWL of salad, cake, soup, cereal
   6 a GLASS of milk, wine, beer, cheese, Coke
   7 a BOTTLE of Coke, beef, water, lemonade
   8 a JAR of honey, jam, potatoes, mustard
   9 a BAG of flour, sugar, ketchup, crisps
   10 a BOX of vinegar, chocolates, biscuits
11) 'Put the foods in the list under the correct headings. Can you add more foods to the list?'
   Qalin sarlavhalar: 'vegetables - dairy products - fish - seafood - meat - fruit - poultry'
   Qiya ro'yxat: broccoli, watermelon, chicken, turkey, salmon, trout, peaches, cheese, butter, yoghurt, beef, peas, lamb, eggs, cabbage, cucumber, brussels sprouts, lettuce, prawns, mussels, veal, apricots, strawberries

O'NG USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Countable/Uncountable Nouns'.
12) 'Which of the words in the list go with: A; AN; SOME? Which are countable? Which are uncountable? In pairs, act out short dialogues, as in the example.'
   Qiya ro'yxat: apple, sweets, hamburger, pasta, orange juice, chips, tea, banana, coffee, milk, chocolates, apricot, eggs, jacket potato, hot dog, grapes, biscuit, peach, bacon
   Ko'k qiya namuna (qalin qismlar bilan):
     SA: Would you like SOME BACON?
     SB: Yes, please. And can I have SOME CHIPS, too?
     SA: Of course. Do you want A PEACH?
     SB: No, thanks. I'd rather have AN APPLE.
• OCh KO'K-YaShIL QUTI, yuqorisida oq katta harflar 'some · any · many · much · a few · a little'. Besh band, misollar TO'Q SARIQ qiya harflarda:
   • 'We use SOME in affirmative sentences with uncountable nouns and plural countable nouns.' - 'There is SOME SPINACH left.' / 'There are SOME CARROTS in the fridge.'
   • 'We use ANY in questions and negations with uncountable nouns and plural countable nouns.' - 'Are there ANY BISCUITS? Yes, but there isn't ANY MILK.' / 'Is there ANY SALT? Yes, but there aren't ANY POTATOES.'
   • 'We use MANY with countable nouns in questions and negations.' - 'How MANY EGGS are there?' / "There aren't MANY ROLLS left."
   • 'We use MUCH with uncountable nouns in questions and negations.' - 'How MUCH BUTTER is there?' / "There isn't MUCH SUGAR left."
   • 'We use A FEW with countable nouns and A LITTLE with uncountable nouns.' - 'There are A FEW EGGS in the bowl. (some; not many)' / 'There is A LITTLE COFFEE in the pot. (some; not much)'
13) 'Fill in SOME, ANY, MUCH, MANY, A FEW or A LITTLE. Then, act out similar dialogues using the prompts below.'
   Ko'rsatmalar: • Spanish omelette: eggs, onions, cheese, milk, ham • pizza: mushrooms, tomatoes, ham, butter, cheese
   A/B dialogi, 13 ta nuqtali joy.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '42'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: bake, boil, poach, steam, fry.
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'ying: bake, boil, poach, steam, fry.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh PIShIRISh USULI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TA'RIFLAR                       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  POACH - qaynoq suvda, PO'STSIZ
     ('without its shell')

  BOIL - qaynoq suvda, PO'STI BILAN
     ('with its shell')

  STEAM - BUG'da (yopiq idishda,
     qaynoq suv USTIDA)

  FRY - QAYNOQ YOG'da (tovada)

  BAKE - DUXOVKAda (quruq issiqda)


⚠ 1 va 2-BANDLAR FARQI:

  1 'without its shell' → POACH
  2 'with its shell' → BOIL

  ⚠ Faqat ShU IKKI SO'Z ('without'
  va 'with') javobni belgilaydi!


⚠ 'A SHELL':

  = po'st, chig'anoq.
  ⚠ 'an eggshell' = tuxum po'sti.


⚠ 'BOILING WATER':

  = qaynayotgan suv.
  ⚠ 'boiled water' = qaynatilgan
  suv - BOShQA ma'no!


⚠ 'A COVERED CONTAINER':

  = qopqoqli idish.
  ⚠ 'to cover' = yopmoq.


⚠ 'AN OVEN':

  = duxovka.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈʌvən/ - 'a' EMAS!
  ⚠ 'IN the oven' - 'in' predlogi.


⚠ 'A PAN':

  = tova.
  ⚠ 'a frying pan' = qovurish tovasi.
  ⚠ 'a saucepan' = kastryul.

exercises.instructionEn: Name some foods which can be fried, poached, baked, boiled or steamed.
exercises.instructionUz: Qovurilishi, suvda pishirilishi, duxovkada pishirilishi, qaynatilishi yoki bug'da pishirilishi mumkin bo'lgan ovqatlarni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Eggs, chicken, mushrooms and bacon
   can be FRIED.'


⚠ MAJHUL NISBAT:

  'can be' + 3-ShAKL (-ed)
  ⚠ 'can be fried', 'can be baked'.
  ⚠ 'can be fry' - XATO!


⚠ HAR USULGA MOS OVQATLAR:

  FRIED: eggs, chicken, mushrooms,
     bacon, sausages, fish, onions
  POACHED: eggs, fish, salmon
  BAKED: bread, cake, biscuits,
     potatoes, chicken
  BOILED: eggs, potatoes, rice,
     pasta, vegetables
  STEAMED: vegetables, rice, fish,
     broccoli, spinach


⚠ 'A JACKET POTATO' = BAKED potato
  (40-betda ham bor edi).

exercises.explanationUz:
IDISh VA O'LChOV SO'ZLARI.


⚠ QOIDA:

  Har qatorda BITTA so'z QALIN idish
  so'ziga MOS KELMAYDI - o'shani
  toping.


TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  1 a bar of ... → BREAD ortiqcha
    ('a bar of chocolate/soap' ✓,
     'a LOAF of bread')
  2 a carton of ... → BACON ortiqcha
    ('a carton of juice/milk' ✓,
     'a RASHER of bacon')
  3 a slice of ... → BUTTER ortiqcha
    ('a slice of bread/ham/cake' ✓,
     'a PACKET of butter')
  4 a cup of ... → MEAT ortiqcha
    (piyolada faqat ichimlik)
  5 a bowl of ... → CAKE ortiqcha
    (kosada suyuq/donador ovqat)
  6 a glass of ... → CHEESE ortiqcha
    (stakanda faqat ichimlik)
  7 a bottle of ... → BEEF ortiqcha
    (shishada faqat suyuqlik)
  8 a jar of ... → POTATOES ortiqcha
    ('a jar of honey/jam/mustard' ✓,
     'a KILO of potatoes')
  9 a bag of ... → KETCHUP ortiqcha
    ('a bag of flour/sugar/crisps' ✓,
     'a BOTTLE of ketchup')
  10 a box of ... → VINEGAR ortiqcha
    ('a box of chocolates/biscuits' ✓,
     'a BOTTLE of vinegar')


⚠ 'A BAR':

  = plitka, bo'lak.
  ⚠ 'a bar of chocolate' = shokolad
  plitkasi.
  ⚠ 'a bar of soap' = sovun bo'lagi.


⚠ 'A CARTON':

  = karton quti (sut, sharbat uchun).


⚠ 'A SLICE':

  = tilim, bo'lak.
  ⚠ 'to slice' = tilimlamoq.


⚠ 'A JAR':

  = banka (shishali, keng og'izli).
  ⚠ 'a bottle' - tor bo'yinli shisha.


⚠ 'CEREAL':

  = donli nonushta (kornfleks).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'serial' (seriya) bilan BIR XIL
  o'qiladi!


⚠ 'CRISPS':

  = kartoshka chipsi (Britaniya).
  ⚠ AQShda 'chips'.
  ⚠ HAR DOIM ko'plikda.


⚠ 'FLOUR':

  = un.
  ⚠ 'flower' (gul) bilan BIR XIL
  o'qiladi: /flaʊə/!


⚠ 'MUSTARD':

  = xantal.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the foods in the list under the correct headings. Can you add more foods to the list?
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi ovqatlarni to'g'ri sarlavhalar ostiga qo'ying. Ro'yxatga yana ovqat qo'sha olasizmi?
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI TOIFA.


JAVOBLAR:

  VEGETABLES (sabzavotlar):
     broccoli, peas, cabbage,
     cucumber, brussels sprouts,
     lettuce

  DAIRY PRODUCTS (sut mahsulotlari):
     cheese, butter, yoghurt, eggs

  FISH (baliq):
     salmon, trout

  SEAFOOD (dengiz mahsulotlari):
     prawns, mussels

  MEAT (go'sht):
     beef, lamb, veal

  FRUIT (mevalar):
     watermelon, peaches, apricots,
     strawberries

  POULTRY (parranda go'shti):
     chicken, turkey


⚠ 'FISH' va 'SEAFOOD' FARQI:

  fish = baliq (salmon, trout, tuna)
  seafood = dengiz mahsulotlari
     (prawns, mussels, crab,
      lobster, squid)

  ⚠ Britaniyada 'seafood' odatda
  baliqni O'Z IChIGA OLMAYDI.


⚠ 'POULTRY':

  = parranda go'shti (tovuq, kurka,
  o'rdak, g'oz).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈpəʊltri/.


⚠ 'DAIRY PRODUCTS':

  = sut mahsulotlari.
  ⚠ 'dairy' o'qilishi /ˈdeəri/.
  ⚠ Tuxum qat'iy sut mahsuloti emas,
  lekin do'konlarda shu bo'limda
  turadi.


⚠ 'VEAL' va 'BEEF':

  veal = buzoq go'shti
  beef = mol go'shti
  lamb = qo'zi/qo'y go'shti
  pork = cho'chqa go'shti

  ⚠ Hayvon va go'sht nomi FARQ
  qiladi:
     cow → beef
     calf → veal
     sheep → lamb/mutton
     pig → pork


⚠ 'FISH' - KO'PLIGI:

  ⚠ 'fish' ko'pligi ham 'FISH'!
  ⚠ 'fishes' faqat TURLAR haqida.


⚠ 'A STRAWBERRY':

  = qulupnay.
  ⚠ Ko'pligi 'strawberrIES'
  ('y' → 'ies').

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the words in the list go with: a; an; some? Which are countable? Which are uncountable?
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi qaysi so'zlar a; an; some bilan keladi? Qaysilari sanaladigan? Qaysilari sanalmaydigan?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh GURUH.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'A' + SANALADIGAN BIRLIK        ║
║  (undosh tovush)                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  a hamburger, a banana,
  a jacket potato, a hot dog,
  a biscuit, a peach


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'AN' + SANALADIGAN BIRLIK       ║
║  (unli tovush)                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  an apple, an apricot


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'SOME' + KO'PLIK yoki           ║
║  SANALMAYDIGAN                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  KO'PLIK (sanaladigan):
     some sweets, some chips,
     some chocolates, some eggs,
     some grapes

  SANALMAYDIGAN:
     some pasta, some orange juice,
     some tea, some coffee,
     some milk, some bacon


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  SANALADIGAN → 'a/an' (birlikda),
     '-s' (ko'plikda)
  SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a/an' YO'Q,
     '-s' YO'Q, 'some' bilan

  ⚠ 'a milk' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'milks' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'some milk' ✓


⚠ 'A' yoki 'AN'?

  ⚠ TOVUShga qarab, HARFga emas!
     an Apple (a - unli)
     an Apricot (a - unli)
     a Hamburger (h - undosh)
     a Hot dog (h - undosh)

  ⚠ 'a Uniform' - 'u' /juː/ deb
  o'qilgani uchun 'a' (35-betda
  ham bor edi).


⚠ 'PASTA' - SANALMAYDIGAN:

  ⚠ 'a pasta' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'a plate of pasta' ✓


⚠ 'GRAPES' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA:

  ⚠ 'a grape' bitta uzum donasi -
  kam ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ 'some grapes' = bir bosh uzum.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Would you like SOME BACON?
  SB: Yes, please. And can I have
      SOME CHIPS, too?
  SA: Of course. Do you want A PEACH?
  SB: No, thanks. I'd rather have
      AN APPLE.


⚠ "I'D RATHER HAVE ...":

  = ... ni afzal ko'raman.
  ⚠ "I'd rather" = 'I would rather'.
  ⚠ Keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l:
  "I'd rather HAVE" ✓
  "I'd rather to have" - XATO!

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, act out short dialogues, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Would you like some bacon?
  SB: Yes, please. And can I have
      some chips, too?
  SA: Of course. Do you want a peach?
  SB: No, thanks. I'd rather have
      an apple.


⚠ 'WOULD YOU LIKE ...?':

  = ... xohlaysizmi? (muloyim taklif)
  ⚠ 'Do you want ...?' dan
  muloyimroq.


⚠ TAKLIFDA 'SOME' - 'ANY' EMAS!

  'Would you like SOME bacon?'
  ⚠ Savol bo'lsa ham 'some'!
  ⚠ Chunki bu TAKLIF, haqiqiy savol
  emas.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'Can I have SOME
  chips?' (iltimos).


⚠ 'YES, PLEASE' va 'NO, THANKS':

  ⚠ Taklifga javob:
     rozi bo'lsang - 'Yes, please.'
     rad qilsang - 'No, thanks.'
  ⚠ 'Yes, thanks' - taklifga MOS
  EMAS.

exercises.instructionEn: some · any · many · much · a few · a little
exercises.instructionUz: some · any · many · much · a few · a little
exercises.explanationUz:
MIQDOR SO'ZLARI - TO'LIQ TIZIM.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SOME - TASDIQ gaplarda          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  sanalmaydigan + KO'PLIK bilan

  'There is SOME spinach left.'
  'There are SOME carrots in the
   fridge.'

  ⚠ ISTISNO: TAKLIF va ILTIMOSda
  savolda ham 'some'!
     'Would you like SOME tea?'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ANY - SAVOL va INKORda          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  sanalmaydigan + KO'PLIK bilan

  'Are there ANY biscuits?'
  "There isn't ANY milk."
  'Is there ANY salt?'
  "There aren't ANY potatoes."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MANY - SANALADIGAN bilan        ║
║  (savol va inkorda)              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'How MANY eggs are there?'
  "There aren't MANY rolls left."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MUCH - SANALMAYDIGAN bilan      ║
║  (savol va inkorda)              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'How MUCH butter is there?'
  "There isn't MUCH sugar left."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  A FEW / A LITTLE                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  A FEW + SANALADIGAN ko'plik
     'There are A FEW eggs in the
      bowl.' (some; not many)

  A LITTLE + SANALMAYDIGAN
     'There is A LITTLE coffee in
      the pot.' (some; not much)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ESLAB QOLISh JADVALI            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SANALADIGAN (eggs):
     many, a few, some, any

  SANALMAYDIGAN (butter):
     much, a little, some, any

  ⚠ 'many butter' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'much eggs' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'a few butter' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'a little eggs' - XATO!


⚠ 'A FEW' va 'FEW':

  a few = bir nechta (IJOBIY)
  few = juda oz (SALBIY)

  ⚠ 41-betdagi maqolada 'FEW of
  these caterers' - SALBIY ma'no.


⚠ 'A LITTLE' va 'LITTLE':

  a little = biroz (IJOBIY)
  little = juda oz (SALBIY)


⚠ 'LEFT':

  'There isn't much sugar LEFT.'
  = shakar KAM QOLDI.
  ⚠ 'left' bu yerda = qolgan.

points.en: We use some in affirmative sentences with uncountable nouns and plural countable nouns.
points.uz: 'some' ni tasdiq gaplarda sanalmaydigan va ko'plikdagi sanaladigan otlar bilan ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'affirmative' = tasdiq.
⚠ ISTISNO: taklif va iltimosda savolda ham 'some'.

points.en: There is some spinach left. / There are some carrots in the fridge.
points.uz: Biroz ismaloq qolgan. / Muzlatgichda bir nechta sabzi bor.

points.en: We use any in questions and negations with uncountable nouns and plural countable nouns.
points.uz: 'any' ni savol va inkor gaplarda sanalmaydigan va ko'plikdagi sanaladigan otlar bilan ishlatamiz.

points.en: Are there any biscuits? Yes, but there isn't any milk. / Is there any salt? Yes, but there aren't any potatoes.
points.uz: Pechenye bormi? Ha, lekin sut yo'q. / Tuz bormi? Ha, lekin kartoshka yo'q.

points.en: We use many with countable nouns in questions and negations.
points.uz: 'many' ni savol va inkorda sanaladigan otlar bilan ishlatamiz.

points.en: How many eggs are there? / There aren't many rolls left.
points.uz: Nechta tuxum bor? / Ko'p bulochka qolmagan.

points.en: We use much with uncountable nouns in questions and negations.
points.uz: 'much' ni savol va inkorda sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ishlatamiz.

points.en: How much butter is there? / There isn't much sugar left.
points.uz: Qancha sariyog' bor? / Ko'p shakar qolmagan.

points.en: We use a few with countable nouns and a little with uncountable nouns.
points.uz: 'a few' ni sanaladigan, 'a little' ni sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: ⚠ 'a few butter' va 'a little eggs' - XATO!

points.en: There are a few eggs in the bowl. (some; not many) / There is a little coffee in the pot. (some; not much)
points.uz: Kosada bir nechta tuxum bor. (biroz; ko'p emas) / Choynakda biroz qahva bor. (biroz; ko'p emas)
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a few' = bir nechta (IJOBIY).
⚠ 'a little' = biroz (IJOBIY).
⚠ 'a' SIZ ('few', 'little') SALBIY ma'no beradi!

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in some, any, much, many, a few or a little.
exercises.instructionUz: some, any, much, many, a few yoki a little ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Have we got what we need for
     the cheeseburgers?
  B: Let me see. Well, there are
     1) SOME burgers, but there
     aren't 2) ANY rolls at all.
  A: How 3) MANY rolls do you need?
  B: Just 4) A FEW. I need 5) SOME
     cheese, too.
  A: How 6) MUCH cheese is there in
     the fridge?
  B: Not 7) MUCH, but I only need
     8) A LITTLE.
  A: Is there 9) ANY ketchup left?
  B: Only 10) A LITTLE, but we don't
     need much, so don't buy 11) ANY.
     We haven't got 12) ANY mustard
     at all, though.
  A: I'll buy 13) SOME, then.


⚠ HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1 TASDIQ + ko'plik → some
  2 INKOR + ko'plik → any
  3 SAVOL + SANALADIGAN → many
  4 sanaladigan, 'bir nechta' →
    a few
  5 TASDIQ + sanalmaydigan → some
  6 SAVOL + SANALMAYDIGAN → much
  7 INKOR + sanalmaydigan → much
  8 sanalmaydigan, 'biroz' →
    a little
  9 SAVOL + sanalmaydigan → any
  10 sanalmaydigan, 'biroz' →
     a little
  11 INKOR (buyruq) → any
  12 INKOR + sanalmaydigan → any
  13 TASDIQ → some


⚠ 11-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  "DON'T buy any" - INKOR BUYRUQ,
  shuning uchun 'any'.


⚠ 'AT ALL':

  = umuman.
  ⚠ Inkorni KUChAYTIRADI:
  "there aren't ANY rolls AT ALL" =
  umuman bulochka yo'q.


⚠ 'THOUGH' GAP OXIRIDA:

  = lekin.
  ⚠ So'zlashuvda gap OXIRIDA keladi.
  ⚠ 35-betda gap o'rtasida ham bor
  edi.


⚠ 'LET ME SEE':

  = qani ko'ray-chi.
  ⚠ O'ylash uchun vaqt oladigan
  ibora.


⚠ 'A CHEESEBURGER':

  = pishloqli burger.
  ⚠ QO'ShIB yoziladi.

  • Spanish omelette: eggs, onions,
    cheese, milk, ham

⚠ SANALADIGAN va SANALMAYDIGAN:

     tomatoes

  SANALMAYDIGAN (much, a little):
     cheese, milk, ham, butter


⚠ 'HAM' - SANALMAYDIGAN:

  ⚠ 'a ham' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'a slice of ham' ✓ (10-mashqda).

  ⚠ 'AN' - 'o' unli tovush.

  piyoz bilan).
  ⚠ 'Spanish' - KATTA harf.
